walls.note: Hole 14 pond: the rough stone edge towards the green, round the west tip (the creek's outlet) and along the north edge to E 477358 (2025 and 2023 orthos).
Pond between 18 and 1: rounded boulders along the south edge (dark in the 2023 ortho, grey in 2025), round the south-west corner and up the west side past the bulge to N 6457447.
Pond behind hole 13's green: the stone rim from the south-west corner up the west side, along the north edge and down the east side (2025 ortho; boulders 0.5-1 m).

Pond behind hole 13's green: the south side back to the south-west corner, so the rim runs all round (Marcus 2026-10-18: the back was missing; the 2025 ortho shows grass and a dark edge there, the 2023 ortho a thin shadowed lip).
Hole 9: the dry-stone wall along the green's north side, on Marcus's line (photos from the drone and the bridge, 2026-10-19).
Hole 9's north tee: the near-vertical dry-stone wall round its west end and north side, on Marcus's line (photo, 2026-10-19).
Pond between 18 and 1: the grey stone rim round the north tip (2025 and 2023 orthos).
